reviews.text: I had the opportunity to visit Le Chatelier during a short stay in Paris. A delightful discovery for me, a cat lover always seeking tranquility. Le Chatelier offered me a relaxing and serene interlude, during which I enjoyed a refreshing drink and the company of the four-legged owners, who were just as adorable as the staff (a special mention for Tala, whom I absolutely adored! 🫶🏼). Located in a lovely neighborhood, near the Panthéon and the Luxembourg Gardens, it's a true treat to stop by!
A very warm and welcoming place! <3
Adorable place, the cats are so cute and the servers are very respectful! I recommend it 100%!

Fantastic afternoon! The place is great, the cats are wonderful, and the staff is fantastic!
We'd love to go back!

Fantastic! The cats and the people who care for them are lovely! The cats are very well cared for and happy. The café also works with an association, and adoptions are sometimes possible, which is great!

Absolutely love it! The team is incredibly kind, and the cats are all more adorable than the next. Board games and cat toys are available to make the visit even more enjoyable. Everything is truly designed for a moment of complete relaxation in excellent company 🥰
A huge thank you to the manager for her warm welcome! You can tell the cats are treated with so much love and respect. It's a wonderful initiative that I will definitely recommend to everyone I know! 🫶🏻
An exceptional place with incredibly lovely staff. Stella is my favorite ❤️
Great time at Le Chatelier! 🐱✨ A really nice place, a pleasant atmosphere and above all adorable cats 😻 A really great experience, I recommend it! …
Wonderful experience!! The owner is super mega nice! The cats are so cute and cuddly! I highly recommend it

A wonderful discovery! 🐱

I was very pleasantly surprised by this place, which is both warm and peaceful, and perfectly suited to cats. You can really tell that their well-being is a priority.

The welcome is very friendly, and the team is attentive and responsive. I highly recommend this place to cat lovers, whether you want to spend a pleasant time or entrust your feline friend to their care with complete confidence.

Thank you to the whole team for your hospitality! 🐾❤️
